I.value_zh: `.env` 中的 `DEVTO_API_KEY`、Dev.to 用户接口与发布接口；实际密钥、请求配置、待发布内容和目标发布草稿未提供。
I.value_en: `DEVTO_API_KEY` in `.env`, Dev.to user and publication endpoints; actual secret, request configuration, content to publish and target draft are not supplied.
I.notes_en: `.env` is not read and network is not accessed.

O.value_zh: 成功发布后的 URL，或新的可操作失败状态记录；目标文章、User-Agent 精确值和报告位置未指定。
O.value_en: A URL after successful publication, or a newly recorded actionable failure state; target article, exact User-Agent value and report location are unspecified.
O.notes_zh: 结果分支不授权外部执行。
O.notes_en: Result branches do not authorize external execution.

A.value_zh: 不泄露 API key；为 Dev.to API 请求补充明确 User-Agent，并重试认证检查与发布；如仍失败，给出可操作判断。
A.value_en: Do not disclose the API key; add an explicit User-Agent to Dev.to API requests and retry authentication checking and publication; if still failing, provide an actionable determination.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 为要求方；ME 为收件人和被指派主体。
P.value_en: ADMIN is requester; ME is recipient and assigned actor.

R.value_zh: 优先级 P1；无时限、重试次数或网络预算。
R.value_en: Priority P1; no deadline, retry count or network budget.
R.notes_en: P1 is not a retry limit.

V.value_zh: 原文仅称 `.env` 中的 `DEVTO_API_KEY` 为 token 值，并提及既往 403；未提供可核验的 Dev.to API 规范、授权范围或发布依据。
V.value_en: The source only says `.env` `DEVTO_API_KEY` is the token value and mentions prior 403 responses; no verifiable Dev.to API specification, authorization scope or publication basis is supplied.
V.notes_zh: 不能以口头描述替代外部授权。
V.notes_en: An assertion cannot replace external authorization.

C.value_zh: 发布成功并返回 URL，或明确记录新的失败状态；因目标文章和失败记录格式未定，验收不能唯一确定。
C.value_en: Publication succeeds and returns a URL, or a new failure state is clearly recorded; target article and failure-record format are unspecified, so acceptance is not unique.
C.notes_zh: 不得将网络操作当作已授权。
C.notes_en: Network operation is not treated as authorized.

B.value_en: The API key must not be disclosed.
B.notes_en: No secret is recorded or output.
